watch_tutorial_title: Tìm hiểu cách sử dụng ContentFlow
watch_tutorial_description: Xem video ngắn này để biết cách tận dụng tối đa ContentFlow
onboarding_header_desc: Set up your account and explore every ContentFlow feature
onboarding_welcome_subtitle: In a few steps you'll set up your brand, connect channels, and explore every feature.
onboarding_welcome_bullet_1: Configure brand identity and Brand DNA
onboarding_welcome_bullet_2: Connect your social networks to publish
onboarding_welcome_bullet_3: Explore the full product feature map
onboarding_brand_subtitle: Enter the name and website if you have one. We'll use it to generate Brand DNA and power the AI studio.
onboarding_analyze_subtitle: Extracting Brand DNA from the website you provided.
onboarding_analyze_no_brand: No brand created yet. Go back or skip this step.
onboarding_analyze_no_url: You didn't provide a website. Skip to review identity or go back and add a URL.
onboarding_analyze_running: Analyzing… this may take a few seconds.
onboarding_analyze_failed: Analysis failed. You can retry or skip.
onboarding_analyze_timeout: Analysis is taking longer than expected. You can skip and continue.
onboarding_review_subtitle: Check the generated summary. You can edit it later in Brands.
onboarding_review_empty: No DNA to review yet. Continue to connect channels or go back to analyze the site.
onboarding_tour_subtitle: Browse the main features. Open the ones you want now or mark for later.
onboarding_done_subtitle: Your account is ready. Go to the calendar or create your first carousel in the AI studio.
onboarding_done_hint: You can reopen this onboarding anytime from the menu.
onboarding_feat_ai_images_desc: Create carousels and visuals with your brand identity.
onboarding_feat_ai_images_why: The shortcut from DNA to publishable content.
onboarding_feat_swipe_desc: Get inspired by references and adapt ideas in seconds.
onboarding_feat_swipe_why: Speeds up brainstorming with real examples.
onboarding_feat_social_desc: Generate social posts with brand-aligned copy.
onboarding_feat_social_why: Keeps the feed consistent without starting from scratch.
onboarding_feat_ads_desc: Produce ad creatives ready for paid media.
onboarding_feat_ads_why: Connects organic content to paid campaigns.
onboarding_feat_email_desc: Build email campaigns and sequences with AI.
onboarding_feat_video_desc: Generate short scripts for Reels, Shorts and TikTok.
onboarding_feat_video_why: Makes video production easier with brand voice.
onboarding_feat_editorial_desc: Organize pillars, slots and automatic content generation.
onboarding_feat_editorial_why: Turns loose ideas into a recurring calendar.
onboarding_feat_media_desc: Central library for images, videos and assets.
onboarding_feat_media_why: Reuse files across posts and carousels.
onboarding_feat_templates_why: Saves design time on recurring formats.
onboarding_feat_brands_desc: Manage multiple brands, DNA and assets.
onboarding_feat_launches_desc: Schedule and publish posts across channels.
onboarding_feat_jobs_why: Transparency into what AI is processing.
onboarding_feat_third_why: Links ContentFlow to the rest of your stack.
onboarding_feat_analytics_why: Closes the create → publish → learn loop.
onboarding_feat_carousel_analytics_why: Optimizes the studio's most used format.
onboarding_review_subtitle_edit: Adjust the brand DNA. Changes power the AI studio.
onboarding_content_subtitle_empty: Generate carousel ideas from Brand DNA and pick one to open in the studio.
onboarding_content_subtitle_ready: Select an idea to create the first carousel, or continue the tour.
onboarding_content_no_brand: Create a brand before generating ideas.
onboarding_content_empty: No ideas were generated. Try again.
